literal_meaning: head hot make (to heat up the head)
figurative_meaning_en: to become agitated or lose one's temper
similar_in_english: to get hot under the collar
example_sentences_in_bangla: মাথা গরম না করে শান্তভাবে চিন্তা করো।
আলোচনায় মাথা গরম হয়ে গেল তার।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't get hot-headed; think calmly instead.
He lost his temper during the discussion.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on maintaining composure in Bengali social interactions.
